title: Twisted Parmesan Puff Pastry Cheese Straws
summary: Puff pastry is rolled with Parmesan, pepper and a little cayenne on both sides, cut into strips, twisted and baked at 220 °C for about 10 minutes until puffed and golden.
equipment: 2 baking trays lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: ready-rolled all-butter puff pastry sheet, chilled
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C and line two trays.

steps.title: Press in the cheese
steps.text: Sprinkle half the Parmesan and seasoning over the pastry and roll it in between baking paper.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Flip, sprinkle the rest on the other side and roll to about 27 cm square.

steps.title: Twist
steps.text: Cut 2 cm strips, twist each one and press the ends onto the trays.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 10-12 minutes until puffed and deep golden.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool 5 minutes on a rack before serving.

tips: Work quickly while the pastry is cold so the layers stay distinct.
Press the ends down firmly or the twists unwind in the oven.
Add smoked paprika for colour and warmth.
storage: Keep airtight at room temperature for up to 3 days; crisp in a 180 °C oven for 3 minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
